_comment: Same-box A/B record for the P1 softmax-scale-fold change (jammi_kernels::ops::softmax's SoftmaxLastDimFused::with_scale folding 1/sqrt(head_dim) into the fused softmax op). The two arms differ by EXACTLY ONE thing: `base` is the training arm BEFORE this change -- ModernBertAttention::forward built a `scores / sqrt(head_dim)` Op::Affine node (a full [batch, heads, seq, seq] retained tape tensor per layer) and then called the fused softmax with scale=1.0; `tip` is the training arm AFTER -- the same 1/sqrt(head_dim) folded directly into SoftmaxLastDimFused via with_scale, so that Op::Affine node is never constructed at all. Nothing else moved: same model config, same LoRA config, same dtype, same step/warmup/seed. peak_vram_bytes is the tier's device-total-minus-baseline (nvidia-smi/pool high-water mark across the whole run), NOT a live/allocator-delta reading -- the same convention documented in finetune_step_reference.json's own _comment. softmax_fused_dispatches/lora_epilogue_fused_dispatches are identical on both legs (700 and 2800 respectively, 0 eager fallbacks on either arm) because this change alters WHEN scale is applied, not WHETHER the fused softmax or LoRA epilogue kernels are admitted -- confirming the two arms really do differ only by the Affine-node removal, not by a change in kernel admission. Arithmetic check for the b8-s512-d0 delta (the row where the removed [B_eff, H, S, S] bf16 tensor is largest): B_eff = 24 is the batched-triplet effective leading dimension this LoRA config's batched-forward (r=16, alpha=32, targets Wqkv/Wo/Wi bf16, batched across the three targets) presents to the attention module, H = 16 heads, S = 512, 2 bytes/element (bf16), 28 layers (ModernBERT-large): 24 * 16 * 512 * 512 * 2 * 28 = 5,637,144,576 bytes = 5.64 GB, matching the measured peak_vram_bytes delta at that row (77,462,503,424 - 71,758,249,984 = 5,704,253,440 bytes = 5.70 GB) to within the same order of overhead (allocator fragmentation/other transient tensors) any single-node removal from a real training step carries -- this is a sanity check on the SIZE of the effect, not a claim of exact equality. RECORD, never gate (heterogeneous-fleet doctrine, same as finetune_step_reference.json).

provenance.base_disposition: P1 absent (branch base: training arm builds an Op::Affine scores/sqrt(head_dim) node before calling the fused softmax with scale=1.0)
provenance.tip_disposition: P1 present (1/sqrt(head_dim) folded into SoftmaxLastDimFused via with_scale; no Op::Affine node built)
